deployment_boundary.global_ref: Mechanically available repository primitive, but coarse because unrelated branch advances conflict.
deployment_boundary.canonical_target_epoch: Mechanically strong but requires both old and new owners to mutate the same canonical target authority object; current per-role CLEAN write boundaries do not expose such a shared target.
deployment_boundary.immutable_owner: Compatible with current no-shared-state CLEAN shape; role-to-role reassignment is deliberately unsupported, while same-role crash/takeover remains handled by the role slot epoch.
